summary: Completed frontend-only testing of the new Next.js 14 static site at https://dr-harsha-nextjs.preview.emergentagent.com. 29/29 HTTP smoke tests (pytest) passed covering homepage, conditions (index + 3 detail), treatments (index + 3 detail), blog (index + auto-discovered post), SEO landing pages (/best-orthopedic-surgeon-hyderabad, /robotic-knee-replacement-hyderabad, /knee-replacement-cost-hyderabad), static pages (/about, /contact, /testimonials, /gallery), /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, 404 fallback, WhatsApp float button on every page, homepage stats (3500+, 15+, 99%, 200+), Apollo reference, phone number, nav links, and confirmation that /contact has ZERO traditional forms. Playwright UI checks on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) also passed — hamburger menu opens on mobile, 43 links visible, no blocking issues. Backend is intentionally stopped (static Next.js site). No critical defects found.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='whatsapp-inline-btn' is defined on the inline variant of the WhatsAppButton component but the component is never rendered in inline mode anywhere — the Header and page.js hero use plain <a href={whatsappUrl()}> tags. Not a functional defect (all CTAs link to wa.me/919959964567 correctly) but the test-id contract in the spec is unmet. Either (a) replace the inline <a> usages in Header.jsx and page.js with <WhatsAppButton variant='inline' />, or (b) add data-testid='whatsapp-inline-btn' directly to those anchor tags.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows multiple 'Failed to fetch RSC payload ... Falling back to browser navigation. TypeError: Failed to fetch' errors when hovering/clicking links (e.g., /conditions/acl-tear, /contact, /gallery, /blog). The preview ingress appears to block or 404 the RSC .txt/.rsc prefetch requests. Next falls back to full-page navigation so functionality still works for the end user, but the noisy console errors will appear in real-user monitoring. On the production Vercel deployment this is likely a non-issue (Vercel serves RSC payloads natively). Worth verifying on Vercel preview before release.

action_items: (Optional/Low) Attach data-testid='whatsapp-inline-btn' to the header/hero WhatsApp anchor tags, or swap them to <WhatsAppButton variant='inline'/>, so the contract in the test spec is fulfilled.
(Optional) Investigate RSC prefetch 'Failed to fetch' console errors on the preview ingress — likely disappears on Vercel production, but verify after deploy.
critical_code_review_comments: All page routes are correctly statically generated and return 200. Build output is 154 static pages (per the handover note).
Contact page has no <form> elements — only WhatsApp and phone CTAs, as required.
Floating WhatsApp button (data-testid='whatsapp-float-btn') is rendered in /app/frontend/app/layout.js and correctly shows on every tested page with href containing wa.me/919959964567.
Sitemap and robots.txt properly generated by /app/frontend/app/sitemap.js and /app/frontend/app/robots.js; sitemap contains conditions, treatments, blog, and SEO landing pages.
data-testid='whatsapp-inline-btn' is declared on the component but never actually rendered — minor spec gap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend supervisor service is intentionally STOPPED. Do NOT attempt /api/* calls. Test target is the static Next.js site at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://dr-harsha-nextjs.preview.emergentagent.com). Regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_static_pages.py — rerun with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_static_pages.py -v`. Only lingering cosmetic observations: (1) whatsapp-inline-btn testid is never rendered, (2) RSC prefetch 'Failed to fetch' console noise on the preview ingress (non-blocking, likely preview-specific).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs to RCA — all required flows pass.
